fragment.purpose: Select the smallest falsifiable capability measurement after exact PR 286 publication and native lifecycle recovery.

whether its locked outputs pass every deterministic criterion

local_learn.observation: The repository already has deterministic runtime generation, executor redaction, criterion coverage validation, and scoring. The highest-information next unit is an actual separately contextualized model response with precommitted leakage checks, not another passive evaluator or storage layer.

evidence_needed: a pre-execution seed commitment, nonce commitment, public-suite digest, executor identity, response schema, fixed success threshold, and fixed claim boundary
validation that the suite contains exactly two tasks for each of the six criteria and that every executor-facing expected field is null
an immutable digest of the exact child-visible request proving it contains no seed, expected value, sealed scorer payload, evaluator-specific answer, or repository mutation authority
one immutable executor response bound to that request digest and identity, with no retry after scoring
a separate deterministic scorer receipt that recomputes every per-case result, criterion coverage, response digest, and final verdict from the locked response
negative evidence for malformed answers, incomplete coverage, identity collision, request contamination, executor unavailability, or any mismatch
expected_outputs: a secret-free public challenge manifest and commitment record
the immutable redacted executor request and locked response digests
a per-case and per-criterion scorer report with exactly one of PASS, FAIL, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
a contamination audit showing whether expected answers or scorer-only data reached the executor context
a truthful statement that this is internal blinded development evidence only and cannot by itself establish AGI or completion
failure_conditions: any expected answer, hidden seed, scorer-only field, or post-score feedback is present in the child-visible request
the suite, threshold, evaluator, or task labels change after any executor output is visible
the executor identity is not separate, performs repository mutation, or cannot return one immutable complete response
any case fails, is missing, is malformed, or cannot be deterministically scored
the scorer receipt or request/response digest binding cannot be reproduced
result.goal: Run one precommitted, secret-seeded 12-case behavioral measurement of a separate non-writing model executor across all six held-out criteria, with expected answers, seed material, evaluator rules, and scorer state absent from the executor-visible context, then lock and mechanically score the response without post-hoc task or threshold changes.
inputs: the merged PR 286 publication/readback result and its internal-only claim boundary
src/agi/heldout.py generate_heldout_suite, executor redaction, validation, and deterministic scoring contracts
a fresh evaluation seed and nonce created only after this unit is frozen and retained outside the child-visible request
one separate non-writing executor context that receives only the 12 public task records, explicit answer schema, and prior-answer state needed by the public task contract
result.parent_continuation: Task Evaluate the exact blinded-measurement receipts with separate bounded-unit and user-level verdicts, then Consolidate Episode and Learn. Return to Root regardless of PASS, FAIL, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. A PASS may justify only a harder fresh or independently operated real-world measurement; it must not be treated as AGI, production evidence, or completion.
result.rollback: Retain the frozen public request, locked response, scorer report, and contamination findings as append-only evidence; do not retry, edit tasks, infer missing answers, activate a Candidate, or promote any capability claim from a contaminated or incomplete trial.
success_conditions: all 12 cases are frozen before execution, cover all six criteria exactly twice, and expose no expected values or seed material to the executor
generator, executor, and scorer identities are distinct and the executor has no repository-writing role
the single locked response is schema-valid and all 12 mechanically scored cases pass under the precommitted rules
re-scoring the locked response produces byte-identical per-case verdicts and report digest
the native invocation journal remains exactly-once valid and all limitations are preserved
